narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>A product is always bigger than both numbers, because multiplying makes things bigger.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>That is what we saw with whole numbers.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Let us test it with these decimals.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Multiplying by a number bigger than one makes a number bigger.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Multiplying by a number less than one makes it smaller.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Compare one point five times four, and zero point five times four.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Then compare zero point five times zero point four with its numbers.
